scope: Read-only exact-checkpoint structural reproduction plus local source repair and tests; no GCloud usage

defects_repaired.name: wrong_qwen_vision_component_path
defects_repaired.impact: The intended explicit vision freeze inspected model.visual, while Qwen3.5 exposes the tower at model.model.visual.
defects_repaired.repair: Use a shared fail-closed Qwen structure guard in qualification and production SFT.

defects_repaired.name: wrong_qwen_cache_config_path
defects_repaired.impact: Training wrote model.config.use_cache while the active language cache is model.model.language_model.config.use_cache, leaving cache enabled during long-sequence backward.
defects_repaired.repair: Disable the actual language-model cache during training and restore it before serving artifact save.

defects_repaired.name: second_backbone_load_for_adapter_reload
defects_repaired.impact: Qualification unnecessarily loaded the full backbone twice, increasing VRAM and wall-time risk.
defects_repaired.repair: Unload the in-memory adapter, reload the serialized adapter into the same frozen base, and safe-merge without a second base load.

defects_repaired.name: qualification_serialization_not_compared
defects_repaired.impact: The prior smoke checked only finite merged logits and did not prove saved adapter reproduction.
defects_repaired.repair: Compare trained, serialized/reloaded, and BF16-merged probe logits under frozen tolerances.

defects_repaired.name: six_lane_validation_macro
defects_repaired.impact: Production SFT diagnostic gave JavaScript and TypeScript one full vote each instead of one combined product family.
defects_repaired.repair: Average JavaScript and TypeScript within their family, then compute the frozen five-family macro.

defects_repaired.name: synthetic_token_accounting_and_loss_plausibility
defects_repaired.impact: The 4096-token probe reported all tokens as active despite 64 masked labels and accepted merely finite loss.
defects_repaired.repair: Report input, masked, and supervised tokens separately and require finite positive losses.

defects_repaired.name: insufficient_sft_finalization_and_resume_reserve
defects_repaired.impact: Production SFT reserved only 60 seconds for validation, serialization, and reload checks, and a bounded stop could lack a checkpoint at its latest optimizer boundary.
defects_repaired.repair: Reserve 600 seconds inside both wall and cost bounds and force a resumable terminal checkpoint for a bounded stop.

timing_risk.assessment: The stale v7 envelope leaves about 22.8 minutes for model load, 11318 backward tokens including the 4096-token envelope, adapter serialization, safe merge, and merged checkpoint write. A replacement card should add controller and backup margin to avoid another avoidable paid retry.
